The video-generation model now creates clips up to 15 seconds long, can be edited step by step via conversation, and costs just $0.07 per second at 720p, 30 percent less than its predecessor. Users who draft in low resolution and upscale only the final result can save even more.
item.content:encoded: Google Deepmind is making Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available.
